name: Marks
examine: Synod-minted coin. Accepted almost everywhere, trusted almost nowhere.

name: Riverbread
examine: A dense loaf baked with river water. Better than it sounds.

name: Smoked eel
examine: Caught where the river spreads into the Wash. Nobody asks what it was eating.

name: Sere saltfig
examine: Dried in the salt pans of Sere. Makes you thirsty, and somehow calmer.

name: Phlegm tonic
examine: Thick, pale and faintly salty. Settles the mind for the next thing you do.

name: Cooling draught
examine: Bitter as regret. Draws whichever bile you're running back towards level.

name: Empty vial
examine: Someone will want this back.

name: Apprentice's athame
examine: A ritual knife, blunt on purpose. The point is where you put it.

name: Occultist's robe
examine: Plain on the outside, stitched with notes on the inside.

name: Fen-leather hood
examine: Smells of the fens. So will you.

name: Bile-stained gloves
examine: Whatever stained them, they held up.

name: Sewn-hide boots
examine: Rat hide, mostly. Warm, mostly.

name: Cracked moonstone ring
examine: A sliver of the second moon, set badly. Hymns come easier wearing it.

name: Gallstone amulet
examine: A polished gallstone on a cord. It makes your temper sharper and your blood thinner.

name: Fen rat carcass
examine: Worth more skinned than whole. Take it to a skinning rack.

name: Vitriol mite carcass
examine: Still fizzing. It wants a lye vat and a glass hook, not your bare hands.

name: Skinning knife
examine: Short, curved and sharper than it looks. For basin wildlife.

name: Glass flensing hook
examine: Acid won't touch glass. Your fingers are another matter. For Scald creatures.

name: Rat gall
examine: A little bag of black bile. Render it down and it keeps for years.

name: Choleric salts
examine: Yellow bile, dried and cut with salt. Burns the tongue; feeds the hotter workings.

name: Melancholic tincture
examine: Black bile drawn into spirit. Cold, slow and patient, like the workings it feeds.

name: Vitriol salts
examine: The salt of the Scald. Use a grain too many and the working takes you with it.

name: Hide-wrapped hood
examine: Stitched in the skinning yard from offcuts nobody else wanted. It shows. It works.

name: Yardmaster's apron
examine: Heavy leather, scrubbed and stained and scrubbed again. Wenna only gives these to people she'd trust with her racks.

name: Apothecary's gloves
examine: Thin, oiled, and stained to the wrist in colours that shouldn't go together.

name: Dreamless draught
examine: Corvin's brew for Edda. It smells like the pond and something sweeter underneath.

name: Sleeper's ribbon
examine: Edda's mother tied it round your wrist and said it would keep the bad nights off. It smells faintly of lavender.

name: Rat pelt
examine: Fen rat. Not much of it.

name: Mite gland
examine: Still sour. The distillers will want this.

name: Vitriol bead
examine: A hard bead of the stuff. Handle with gloves.
